name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Official MediaFetch v1.0.0 release. Apple AMOLED theme, 3-tier icon themes, Search Studio, and multi-threaded engine.
Rectangular Glow Fix: Fixed Skia shadow clipping on active category tabs and platform pills, restoring soft, organic pill-shaped glows.
Settings Theme Redesign: Streamlined Theme Studio by placing Amoled, Glass, and Aurora single-line buttons on top, and removed live preview box.
Sync App Icon With Theme Toggle: Added a dedicated toggle switch to dynamically sync brand logo color with the selected theme or lock previous color.
Continuous Platform Marquee: Added smooth infinite 60fps marquee animation for platform pills on homepage.
